[[File:SWMC40_Bacta_mask.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Luke Skywalker wearing a bacta mask]]
{{Quote|The bacta are growing well. Those scars should be gone in a day or so.|2-1B removing Luke Skywalker's bacta mask|<ref name="MC40">[[Star Wars (1977) 40|''Star Wars'' (1977) 40]]</ref>}}
A '''bacta mask''' was a mask infused with [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] that was used to heal facial injuries. [[2-1B/Legends|2-1B]] applied one such mask to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] after he sustained a [[Wampa/Legends|wampa]] attack prior to the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="MC40" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SWInsider_119_Bacta_mask.jpg|The bacta mask from a deleted scene|thumb|right|250px]]
The bacta mask used to heal Luke Skywalker appeared in filmed but unused scenes from [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="SWI119">{{InsiderCite|119|The Empire Strikes Fact!|The Empire Strikes ''Fact!''}}</ref> Still photos from the scene have appeared in various places, and were the basis for the scene's inclusion in the [[Marvel Comics]] adaptation of the film.<ref name="MC40" />

[[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] sources first used the term "bacta mask" in the [[2010]] article "[[The Empire Strikes Fact!]]"
